headline: Let the forecast shape your home
intro: Weather is a building block in Home Assistant: it defines a shared weather entity, while a provider integration connects to the service that supplies the data. Choose a provider, then use its current conditions and supported forecasts in dashboards, templates, and automations.
highlights: Read a standard condition such as rainy, snowy, or partly cloudy from the weather entity state
Use available measurements such as temperature, humidity, wind, and visibility, with units reported by the entity
Request hourly or daily forecasts with weather.get_forecasts and use the response in a template sensor

flow.title: Turn forecast data into a sensor
